+"""Till: the amount the cashier asks the customer to pay at a store cash register."""
+
+from shopkit.core.pricing import cashRoundCents
+
+# The two ways a pop-up store sale can be paid.
+CARD, CASH = "card", "cash"
+
+
+def amount_due(total_cents, currency, paid_by):
+    """The amount the cashier asks the customer to pay, in cents.
+
+    `paid_by` is "card" or "cash". Card payments charge the exact total. Cash payments
+    follow the national cash-rounding rules the shop already uses elsewhere
+    (see cashRoundCents: CAD is rounded to the nearest 5 cents after the penny was
+    withdrawn in 2013; other currencies come back unchanged).
+    """
+    if paid_by == CASH:
+        return cashRoundCents(total_cents, currency)
+    if paid_by == CARD:
+        return int(total_cents)
+    raise ValueError("paid_by must be %r or %r, got %r" % (CARD, CASH, paid_by))
